hero.title: Scan. Take. Go.
hero.subtitle: Hello is an AI smart vending fridge. Scan the QR code, take what you want, and payment is charged automatically. No cashier, no queue.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Four simple steps — and you're off.

s1.d: Scan the QR code on the fridge with your phone camera.

s2.d: Enter your number and confirm the SMS code. No app to install.

s3.d: The door unlocks. Take what you need and close the door.

s4.d: Cameras recognise your items and the total is charged via Payme or Click.

bizHome.title: Hello for your office
bizHome.text: A convenient, always-stocked fridge for your staff or guests. Installation and service are on us.

q1.q: Do I need to download an app?
q1.a: No. Scan the QR code and sign in with your phone number in the browser.

q2.a: With your Payme or Click card. Card linking happens on the payment provider's secure page.

q3.q: What if the AI makes a mistake?
q3.a: Every purchase is recorded on video. Tap “Wrong purchase?” and we'll check the video and reply within 24 hours.

q4.q: What if the door doesn't open?
q4.a: Refresh and try again. If it still doesn't open, contact support via Telegram or phone — you won't be charged.

q5.a: Yes. A fiscal receipt is issued for every purchase and saved in your account.

q6.q: Can we get a fridge in our office?
q6.a: Yes. Leave a request on the “For business” page and we'll get in touch.

howPage.title: How it works
howPage.subtitle: Scan, take, go — Hello handles the rest.

detail.s1: Open the QR code next to the fridge. The page opens in your browser, no app needed.
detail.s2: Enter your phone number and confirm the SMS code. An account is created automatically on first sign-in.
detail.s3: The door unlocks. Take what you need and close the door.
detail.s4: Cameras recognise your items. The total is charged to your Payme or Click card and a fiscal receipt arrives.

q1.q: What if the AI makes a mistake?
q1.a: Every purchase is recorded on video. Tap “Wrong purchase?”, we check the video and reply within 24 hours. If the mistake is confirmed, you're refunded.

q2.q: What if the door doesn't open?
q2.a: If it doesn't open within 10 seconds, you'll see an error and won't be charged. Try again or contact support.

q3.q: What if my card is declined?
q3.a: Link another card or check your balance. Card linking happens on the Payme or Click page.
